5929-7507-7874-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5929-7507-7874-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

104-3490-4659-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4659-8333.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

4331-4993-5116-8176.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Repeat.

529-5641-6968-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

132-3053-3263-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
132-3053-3263-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-3053-3263-4687.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if you control lands with at least four basic land types.

3175-3991-8095.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-3099-4289-4927.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1368-3499-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3499-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1495-4120-7741.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4120-7741.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-4120-7741.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

874-1170-4808-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
874-1170-4808-6862.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-4808-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1624-4910-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Alchemist's Refuge by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as if they had flash.
Cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2292-2961-3175.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

7-2292-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-2292-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1169-1409-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1169-1409-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-3259-3968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-3968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

11-4872-6555-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-4872-6555-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Time Warp spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Time Warp spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Time Warp and returning the original Time Warp to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Time Warp from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

3755-4050-5010-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1245-6705.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures
1245-6705.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2438-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
2438-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2438-5434-5555-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

1430-5011-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3750-6006.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
3750-6006.description:
Activate at least five creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2558-2829-5687-5690.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Ruination Guide, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

85-940-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
85-940-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

67-2292-2517-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
67-2292-2517-5276.description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 4, returning Reveillark from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

328-338-4499-4929.notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Cryptic Trilobite.
328-338-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Gray Merchant.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Cryptic Trilobite triggers, putting at least two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

779-2546-3284-5014.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

453-1990-2743.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other creatures.
453-1990-2743.description:
Cast Worldly Tutor by paying {G}, causing you to search your library for Biovisionary, then shuffle your library and put Biovisionary on top of it.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Deceiver of Form triggers, revealing Biovisionary from the top of your library and causing all other creatures you control to become copies of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Deceiver of Form and each Biovisionary trigger.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

813-1181-5100.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying {4}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Sacrifice and Return Upon the Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

774-4826-5233.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison triggers, targeting itself.
With the trigger on the stack, tap Boros Garrison for {W}{R}.
Allow the trigger to resolve, returning Boros Garrison to your hand.
Repeat.

262-1874-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-1874-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Ajani's Welcome three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
